claims.text: The hotel is on Rangiroa, a coral atoll in the Tuamotu Archipelago of French Polynesia.

findings.quote: Rangiroa, a coral atoll situated in the Tuamotu archipelago in French Polynesia

claims.text: It sits on Rangiroa's northeastern coast, between the Avatoru and Tiputa passes.

findings.quote: Located on the northeastern coast between the two passes of Avatoru and Tiputa

claims.text: The hotel is at the end of the main islet, between the airport and the Tiputa Pass.

findings.quote: The village of Avatoru is located on the western end of the main 12 kilometre islet. On the other end between the airport and the famous Tiputa Pass you will find the Hotel Kia Ora Resort & Spa.

claims.text: Rangiroa is the largest atoll in French Polynesia, about 340 km northeast of Tahiti.

findings.quote: Rangiroa is the largest atoll in French Polynesia
situated 340 km northeast of Tahiti

claims.text: The atoll is a ring of over 240 small motus, or islets, with the turquoise lagoon on one side and the deep blue ocean on the other.

findings.quote: The island is made up of over 240 small motus (islets) in the shape of a ring.
On one side is the lagoon and its turquoise waters and on the other side the deep blue ocean

claims.text: The bungalows' decoration is a tribute to traditional Polynesian craftsmanship.

findings.quote: the bungalows, whose decoration is a tribute to traditional Polynesian craftsmanship

claims.text: Each bungalow has a terrace for relaxing, sunbathing or looking up at the starry sky.

findings.quote: Each of the unique bungalows has a terrace where you can relax, sunbathe or enjoy the beautiful starry sky.

claims.text: The Poekura Spa, whose name means Pearl of Light in Tahitian, sits in the heart of the hotel's coconut grove.

findings.quote: Nestled in the heart of the hotel’s coconut grove, the Poekura Spa, which means “Pearl of Light” in Tahitian

claims.text: Spa treatments include the traditional Polynesian Taurumi massage, using Sothys products or the spa's own oils made with ingredients such as monoi, tamanu and vanilla.

findings.quote: the famous traditional Polynesian massage – Taurumi
our therapists use the prestigious products of the Sothys brand or the oils from the exclusive Poekura Spa range, created with Polynesian ingredients such as monoi, tamanu, vanilla

claims.text: The Aito Fitness Center is also set in the coconut grove.

findings.quote: Nestled in the heart of the hotel’s coconut grove, the Aito Fitness Center

claims.text: A buffet and barbecue with a Polynesian dance show is held every Wednesday and Sunday night.

findings.quote: Buffet / BBQ with Polynesian dance show every Wednesday & Sunday nights

claims.text: The Blue Velvet Diving Center is right at the hotel, and dives depart from the hotel's pontoon; divers can see dolphins, manta rays and grey sharks all year round.

findings.quote: The Blue Velvet Diving Center is located right at the Hotel Kia Ora Resort & Spa. Diving departures are made right from the hotel’s pontoon.
You can observe dolphins, manta rays, grey sharks and many other species in tropical temperature water all year round.

claims.text: Villas and bungalows are set in the coconut grove, along the beach and over the lagoon, with categories including Overwater Bungalows and Villas with pool.

findings.quote: 58 private villas and bungalows located in the coconut grove, along the beach and over the lagoon.
#### Overwater Bungalow
#### Villa with pool

claims.text: An infinity pool faces the lagoon.

findings.quote: relax in the infinity pool facing the lagoon

claims.text: The Miki Miki Bar is built on stilts over the lagoon, a spot for watching the sunset.

findings.quote: The Miki Miki Bar is built on stilts over the magnificent lagoon of Rangiroa.
It is a prime location to admire the colorful lagoon and especially the sunsets

claims.text: The hotel's favorite excursions are the Blue Lagoon, Reef Island and drift snorkeling in the Tiputa Pass.

findings.quote: Our favorite excursions are: Blue Lagoon, Reef Island, and Drift snorkeling in the Tiputa pass.

claims.text: The hotel recommends booking dives ahead of time.

findings.quote: We highly recommend to book your dives ahead of time.

claims.text: A dress code applies at the bar and restaurant: bathing suits are not allowed, and in the evening men need trousers or Bermuda shorts and shoes.

findings.quote: During the night: Bathing suits are not allowed. For men collared shirts are preferred; Tank Tops are not permitted; Bermuda shorts or trousers and shoes are required.
For Dinner: Bathing suits are not allowed. For men collared shirts are preferred; Tank Tops are not permitted; Bermuda shorts or trousers and shoes are required.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes that the remote atoll location requires connecting flights.
